## Context and problem statement

::: content-hidden
State the context and some background on the issue, then write the problem
statement in the form of a question.
:::

Everywhere you look (at least in the programming world) there are talks of AI
and agents. It's difficult to **not** see it.

*Should we try to incorporate LLM coding assistants and agents in our work (at
least from an organizational/group perspective)?*

## Decision drivers

::: content-hidden
List the main reasons for why we are making this decision, including any issues
that have arisen and that directly impact our work.
:::

## Considered options

This decision post is a bit different from the other posts as we aren't
comparing one tool with another tool, but rather, whether we actually use them
at all. So we've broken the "options" into categories based on the decision
drivers. There are many things we could go into, but we'll decide on AI or not
based on these groupings:

- Development of expertise in the group members
- Ownership and control
- Productivity (bugs, features, maintenance)
- Environmental impact
